name: even-better
description: After Claude finishes some work, Even Better offers to look for a better way: a quick check reviews the change (with optional web research), and a popup above the prompt offers Learn more, Accept or Decline.

level.title: When to offer a look
level.description: every: after every reply, any suggestion. work: after turns that edited files or used 3+ tools, medium/high confidence. sure: same turns, only high-confidence improvements. manual: only when you type /even-better.

debugLog.title: Debug log
debugLog.description: Write each decision Even Better makes to even-better.log in your temp folder.
